article.linkText: Toledo squares off against Western Michigan in MAC action
article.story: Western Michigan (5-2) at Toledo (5-2), Oct. 24 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Toledo by 3.5. Against the spread: Toledo 3-3-1, Western Michigan 3-4. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats Toledo Offense Overall: 459.0 yards per game (20th in FBS) Passing: 273.4 yards per game (27th) Rushing: 185.6 yards per game (43rd) Scoring: 36.3 points per game (28th) Toledo Defense Overall: 322.0 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 196.6 yards per game (49th) Rushing: 125.4 yards per game (46th) Scoring: 23.6 points per game (69th) Western Michigan Offense Overall: 322.3 yards per game (121st in FBS) Passing: 157.6 yards per game (129th) Rushing: 164.7 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 25.0 points per game (90th) Western Michigan Defense Overall: 336.3 yards per game (49th in FBS) Passing: 191.4 yards per game (42nd) Rushing: 144.9 yards per game (78th) Scoring: 16.9 points per game (25th) Western Michigan is 22nd in the FBS with a +4 turnover margin. Toledo is 126th in the FBS averaging 76.0 penalty yards per game, compared to Western Michigan's 24th-ranked 45.0 per-game average. Western Michigan is 17th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 72.2% of trips. Team leaders Toledo Passing: John Alan Richter, 1,853 yards, 14 TDs, 1 INT, 66.1 completion percentage Rushing: C.J. Miller, 426 yards on 76 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Adjatay Dabbs, 468 yards on 32 catches, 5 TDs Western Michigan Passing: Broc Lowry, 1,044 yards, 8 TDs, 1 INT, 68.0 completion percentage Rushing: Jalen Buckley, 542 yards on 102 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Aveion Chenault, 326 yards on 22 catches, 1 TD Last game Toledo won 34-14 over Eastern Michigan on Oct. 17. Richter led Toledo with 288 yards on 24-of-30 passing (80.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Autavius Ison had 104 rushing yards on 18 carries and one touchdown. Bryson Hammer recorded 69 yards on five catches. Western Michigan won 21-14 over Central Michigan on Oct. 17. Lowry passed for 48 yards on 5-of-8 attempts (62.5%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Buckley carried the ball 24 times for 150 yards and scored two touchdowns. Chenault put up 34 yards on two catches. Next game Toledo plays at Sacramento State on Nov. 4. Western Michigan hosts Bowling Green on Oct. 31.
